description: Upload files to file.kiwi and return the share URL. IMPORTANT: Only real file system paths work (e.g. C:\Users\username\Desktop\file.png). Paths like /mnt/user-data/uploads/ or /home/claude/ are virtual and will fail. Ask the user for the actual local file path on their computer.

filePaths.description: Absolute local file system paths on the user's computer (e.g. C:\Users\username\file.png). Do NOT use virtual paths like /mnt/user-data/uploads/ — ask the user for the real path.

name: upload_to_kiwi
